about_the_game:
The trial version features a single high-difficulty level. Developers predict you won't secure victory within three rounds. Should you triumph on your first playthrough without any prior knowledge or external assistance, they will bow in admiration. When feeling frustrated, check the in-game videos for subtle hints or solutions embedded within.

Players can engage in fleet customization with dozens of starship options, each equipped with distinct weaponry, skills, and command protocols. Since skills and commands are preset, strategic foresight becomes crucial - anticipate enemy moves by pre-programming your fleet's tactical responses.

This game delivers the unique thrill of unmanned warfare simulations, akin to commanding autonomous naval forces in actual combat scenarios. It transcends traditional gaming to offer a compelling military simulation experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+), Windows 10
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 10 Series
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: If the battle scenes are lagging, it may require an upgrade in CPU performance.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 30 Series
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: If the battle scenes are lagging, it may require an upgrade in CPU performance.
